repos_data.description: A MacOS menu bar app for ChatGPT, Gemini,  Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, DeepSeek, Grok and many more into one streamlined interface
🛡️ Warden - A Fully Native AI Chat App For macOS
Talk to your Mac — a native macOS voice assistant that sees your screen, drives your Mac, and answers back. Powered by the OpenAI Realtime API. Open source.

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.

A lightweight macOS selection translator built with pure Swift 6, featuring on-device Apple Translate for privacy, only 5MB install size and stable ~50MB memory usage. 一款轻量级 macOS 划词翻译工具，纯 Swift 6 开发，设备端 Apple 翻译保护隐私，安装体积仅 5MB，后台运行内存稳定约 50MB
Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
Menu bar app that types your script into any app - one block per hotkey press, as real keystrokes at a human pace. For demos, screencasts, and presentations.
Spotlight alternative and shortcut toolkit for macOS

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
The best open-source alternative to Superwhisper & Wispr Flow. Voice-to-text app for macOS with no subscription

repo_meta_data.description: Native macOS menu-bar AI assistant & query router. Ask instantly with a hotkey — get fast in-app BYOK answers or route to ChatGPT & CLI agents in 1 click.
